subject: Discovery notes + commercial guardrails / decision owners - Greenbridge AI
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenbridge.ai>, Priya Subramani <priya@greenbridge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Greenbridge discovery — quick recap + next steps

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the time this afternoon. Quick recap of what we covered and suggested next moves so we have shared clarity: 

Pain points you highlighted:
- Production latency spikes during peak chat loads (tail latencies > 400ms on 95th percentile) impacting customer experience.
- High token spend on reranking flows and embeddings pipeline; current estimates are ~1.8M tokens/day and growing.
- Difficulty adding model variants for fallback without rewriting significant parts of the inference pipeline.

Current stack and constraints:
- In-house routing + a managed endpoint (Vendor X) for heavy models. KV cache is DIY (Redis-based) and not consistently hit.
- Need SOC2 evidence for vendor onboarding — security team must see logs/retention and isolation guarantees.

Success criteria you listed:
- <150ms median and <280ms 95th for interactive chat (10k reqs/day initial).
- 20–30% unit-cost improvement on same quality for reranking traffic.
- SOC2 evidence and ability to run in a VPC for regulated customers.

Initial commercial / procurement guardrails (to make next steps productive):
- Timeline: Procurement + legal cycle ~4–6 weeks once scope and draft MSA are shared.
- Decision owners: Priya (CTO) and Rahul (Procurement lead) as primary approvers, Alex as technical sponsor.
- Rough budget band: looking to confirm — can you indicate an expected annual run-rate range (ballpark) so we size Dedicated vs Hosted?

Suggested next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive: schedule with your infra team (KV cache, load profile) — 60–90 minute session — proposed week of Aug 3.
2) I will share a short mutual-action-plan (attached) and a SOC2 checklist PDF you can circulate to security.
3) If you can share a tentative budget range and preferred contracting cadence (monthly vs annual), we can pull together preliminary guardrails and a draft term sheet for procurement.

I attached the mutual-action-plan.xlsx and SOC2-evidence-ask.pdf for reference.

Thanks — will follow up in a day to lock the deep-dive.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenbridge.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Subramani <priya@greenbridge.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 17:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenbridge discovery — quick recap + next steps

Sergio — thank you for the clear recap, this is exactly the kind of summary I needed to brief the rest of the team. A few clarifications: 

- The 400ms tail is what we see today on vendor X for sequences ~512 tokens. Peak concurrency 50–80.
- Our security team will need the SOC2 checklist and sample logs retention (<90 days) + data residency notes. Priya is copied.
- Procurement: Rahul is the person who runs the legal/procurement lane — looping him in below. Our expected initial spend band for proof-of-concept is roughly $12k–$25k/month depending on whether we go hosted or reserved. If dedicated, we'd consider a 6–12 month commit.

Can we target the technical deep-dive on Tue, Aug 4 at 10:00 PT? That will put us in time for internal review the following week. Also attaching a short internal procurement intake template — happy to fill details after the tech call.

On short notice: are there obvious minimums (e.g., minimum committed GPU hours) or lead times for dedicated capacity we should expect?

Thanks — look forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Alex
Principal Engineer, Greenbridge AI
alex.chen@greenbridge.ai

Team — forwarding the thread with Alex / Priya from Greenbridge. Key asks / context: 

- Decision timeline: procurement + legal 4–6 weeks after we provide draft MSA + guardrails.
- Budget band they shared for POC: $12k–$25k / month; willing to consider 6–12 month commit for Dedicated.
- Technical goals: <280ms 95th, desire for VPC/SOC2 evidence, KV cache reliability.

Attachments we sent: mutual-action-plan.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-ask.pdf (attached). Alex proposed a tech deep-dive Tue Aug 4 10:00 PT.

Ask: can you two prepare —
1) A 1-page pricing guardrail (hosted vs reserved/dedicated) with likely discount bands for a 6 vs 12 month commit and an estimated monthly run-rate for their reported 1.8M tokens/day? Include options for a hybrid routing setup (hosted for burst + dedicated baseline).
2) A short answers doc for SOC2 questions + a pointer to where audit artifacts live (internal link).
3) If we have any lead-time constraints for Dedicated onboarding (capacity lead time, minimum commit), flag them.

I will schedule the tech deep-dive after I get your availability. 

—
Sergio
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Greenbridge discovery — commercial guardrails + decision owners

Thanks for the forward — quick take and I can have a first-pass pack by EOD Monday. High level guardrails (preliminary):

- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): likely $15k–$30k / month for their current profile; no long-term commit, faster time-to-value, good for POC.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): estimated $9k–$18k / month net (after standard reserved discounts) for a 6-month commit; better predictable throughput and tail-latency SLOs. 12-month commits move further down ~15% on the net rate.
- Hybrid approach recommended: Dedicated baseline sized for 70% of sustained load + hosted burst to handle spikes (reduces unit cost while keeping headroom).

Discount bands (rule-of-thumb): 6-month commit ~15% off listed dedicated rates, 12-month ~25% off (depending on utilization & support SLA). We should confirm support/observability add-ons as separate line items.

Dedicated lead time: 10–14 business days to provision and baseline test once contract and capacity are committed (can be faster if we pre-approve standard configs).

I'll assemble a short one-pager, a simple price table with the bands above, and a one-paragraph SOC2 answers doc. I'll attach the files to the HubSpot deal and share the DocuSign-ready draft MSA once we agree on guardrails.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
